== Notes ==
* Damage is done before checking if the target has hexes or enchantments. This is relevant if the target is under the effect of skills such as [[Reversal of Fortune]] or [[Spinal Shivers]].
* If the target has 3 enchantments or less, this skill can provide the longest lasting poison condition of all skills. Otherwise, [[Envenom Enchantments]] will last longer.
